3.text:
Testifier:
Jeff Wosje, Mayor, City of Plymouth

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3482 be laid over.

S.F. 4371: Senator Bahr: City of Ramsey special tax increment financing authority
modifications.

Senator Weber moved the A-2 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Brian Hagan, City Administrator, City of Ramsey

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4371, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 4586: Senator Pha: Brooklyn Center special tax increment financing authority
authorization.

Testifier:
April Graves, Mayor City of Brooklyn Center

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4586 be laid over.

S.F. 5155: Senator Oumou Verbeten: Extension provision of the five-year rule for a St.
Paul tax increment financing district.

Testifiers:

Jenny Wolfe, Debt Administrator, Department of Planning and Economic Development, City of
St. Paul

Melanie McMahon, Executive Project Lead, City of St. Paul

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5155 be laid over.

S.F. 4919: Senator Putnam: City of St. Cloud special tax increment financing authority
provision.

Testifier:
Cathy Mehelich, Economic Development Director, City of St. Cloud

Senator Ann H. Rest moved that S.F. 4919 be laid over.

S.F. 5254: Senator Hoffman: Brooklyn Park special authority provision related to property
taxes, tax increment financing, and sales and use taxes for certain projects.

Senator Weber moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the amendment was
adopted.

Testifiers:
Hollis Winston, Mayor, Brooklyn Park
Jason Aarsvold, Senior Municipal Advisor, Ehlers' Minnesota

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5254, as amended, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 10:22 a.m.

lie A. Kit

Senator Ann H. Rest, Chair Mitch Berggren, Committee Administrator
